name: Waveform
description: Waveform monitor of the luma or of R, G, B, per column or per row (scope).

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 column (levels up the picture, one waveform column per input column), 1 row (levels across, one trace row per input row)

params.name: components
params.description: 0 luma (BT.709) in white, 1 red, green and blue in their colors

params.name: display
params.description: With `components`=1: 0 overlay, 1 parade (the three components side by side or stacked)

params.name: intensity
params.description: Brightness added by one pixel on a 256-level scale (as FFmpeg), so ~25 equal pixels reach white

params.name: max_samples
params.description: Samples per input line; lines longer than this are sampled at even steps, which bounds the work of each output pixel

params.name: opacity
params.description: Blend over the input picture: 1 = only the generated picture, 0 = the input unchanged
